title: Kudarika Pamhenderekedzo yeGungwa
intro: Unomira pamusoro pejecha remahombekombe akakanganikwa, uko mafungu anonzwika sevanhu vakaedzwa nemurairo waMwari. Mhepo yakazara nekurangarira kutyorwa kwakakonzera shanduko inoshamisa. Mweya iyi yaiva vanaani, uye chii chaive rudzi rwemuedzo wavo?
clues: Taiva nzanga yakagamuchira murairo wakajeka kubva kuna Ishe wedu, asi takawana nzira dzekuuramba.
Taigara pedyo nemvura, uye raramo yedu yaitsamira pazvisikwa zvayo.
Muedzo wakauya kwatiri pazuva ratakarayirwa kuti tirege kuita zvinhu zvenyika.
Zvisikwa zvemumvura zvakauya kwatiri zvakawanda pazuva iroro, zvikatiedza zvisingagoni kutsungiririka.
Takaronga manomano ekunyengera kuti tidzivise murayiro waMwari, tichifunga kuti taigona kukunda murayiro wacho.
Kudarika kwedu kwakatungamira pakushanduka kunonyadzisa; takava tsoko dzinoshoreka nemurairo waAllah.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
